maya: Heads up — thinking about a cheap-variant routing change for economy-tier customers. Goal: shave token cost on large prompts without blowing latency SLOs. Need engineering + product tradeoff input.
kevin: Sounds reasonable. Do you mean automatic reroute to a lower-cost quantized variant when projected token cost > X? :thinking:
maya: Exactly. Server-side decision based on estimated token count + per-token cost. We already have variant metadata (Q, perf, cost). Idea: if estimated_cost_per_call > tier_budget then prefer cheaper_variant, but only if last-mile latency impact < SLO.
alex: Two quick concerns: 1) estimation accuracy for token count (users may stream) and 2) KV-cache/priming mismatch if we swap variants mid-session — cold KV caches can spike latency.
sara: For (1) we can use prompt length + historical avg generation length per route to estimate. For streaming, fallback only after the first chunk? alternatively use a per-request `token_budget_cents` override in API.
kevin: API debate: should this be a server policy (tier -> variant preference) or a per-request opt-in flag like `economy_prefer_cheaper: true`? Server policy is simpler for PLG and prevents gaming, but per-request gives app control.
maya: Prefer server policy + opt-out. Default to server-managed for economy tier, allow `routing_hint` to override for enterprise.
alex: About cache cold-starts: we can gate swaps on whether the destination variant has a warm KV for that model/version and route to cheaper variant only if warm or if projected latency delta < 50ms.
sara: Telemetry needs: per-request fields for "variant_selected", "projected_cost", "actual_tokens", "latency_ms", and an annotation for "swap_reason" (e.g., cost_threshold, capacity_fallback). Console needs a per-route cost delta chart and rollback link.
maya: Example policy draft:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  match: tier == "economy"
  prefer_variant: "redwood-gptx-8q"
  max_token_cost_usd: 0.0004
  fallback_variant: "redwood-gptx-4q"
  latency_slo_ms: 300
  allow_user_override: false
```
kevin: I like that. For rollout UX: canary at 5% for 24h, ascend to 25/50/100 with automated checks: error_rate > 0.5% OR p95_latency > latency_slo*1.3 triggers rollback. Add cost-savings metric target too.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary routing-policy "economy-cost-optim" -> deployed to canary (5%) at 1795551220 :rocket:
ops-bot: ticket RM-423 created: "Economy routing: cost-based variant preference + telemetry". Assigned to @sara.
sara: I'll add telemetry + console mockups. Proposal: per-route "savings_estimate" sparkline and a button to view sample requests that were swapped. Also surface per-customer token budget burn-down for monthly quotas.
alex: Implementation note: keep the routing decision idempotent and deterministic (hashing + policy) so can be replayed in logs. Also emit a routing_decision_id so we can trace through the tracing pipeline.
maya: good call. Also add a safety net: if cheaper variant's output quality (measured by recent evals) drops below threshold, stop routing there automatically. This ties into Optimize signals.
kevin: One more API-level control: `max_tokens_cost_override` for SAs to set a higher ceiling for specific customers. That would need admin console UI + audit log.
sara: UX question: do we expose per-variant cost to customers in the console? I think yes but as approximate numbers, with a tooltip explaining variability.
maya: Action items: (1) eng-runtime to prototype policy engine flags + deterministic decision id, (2) eng-platform to add telemetry fields and console mocks, (3) product to define rollout thresholds and admin override UX.
kevin: I'll take (1) prototype, 2-day spike. Will warn about cache implications in PR.
sara: I'll wire telemetry and prototype a console panel, cc product for mocks.
maya: Thanks — we'll sync in 2d. :thumbsup:
kevin: +1
deploy-bot: rollout: "economy-cost-optim" canary -> 5% confirmed at 1795551300
ops-bot: note: will collect a 48h cost/latency report automatically.
maya: if anyone wants to play with the config locally: `curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"policy":"economy-cost-optim","percent":5}' https://internal-admin.redwood/api/v1/routing`
alex: Also adding a unit test suggestion: simulate streaming + mid-request swap should be explicitly disallowed; ensure API returns a stable variant_id for requests once started.
kevin: OK wrapping up — will open PR with policy proto + docs. Thanks all.
